name: Maikaze no Melt -Where Leads to Feeling Destination-
original_name: 舞風のメルト -Where leads to feeling destination-
source:
This is the fandisk for Suzukaze no Melt. In addition to after stories for the 5 main heroines, a new heroine is introduced (the goddess Kureha) and there will be a harem route as well. Of course subcharacters also have their time in the spotlight with Yui, Fuu, Haruna, Reona and Mina all getting mini stories.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/06/01/june-2011-eroge-releases//]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是《凉风的Melt》的Fan Disc。除了五名主要女主角的后日谈外，还将加入新女主角红叶女神，以及后宫路线。配角同样有自己的舞台：结衣、风、春菜、玲于奈和美奈都会获得迷你故事。

[摘自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/06/01/june-2011-eroge-releases//]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
